name: uncle-sam-junk-removal
title: Uncle Sam Junk Removal
description: Read-only service discovery, service-area checks, planning prices, hauling policy, business information, and customer-review quote links for Uncle Sam Junk Removal in the Evansville Tri-State.
note: Informational discovery metadata. The authoritative runtime discovery mechanism is the MCP server/discover RPC at the endpoint above.

tools.name: listServices
tools.description: List services and match a plain-language junk-removal job description.

tools.name: checkServiceArea
tools.description: Check a city, ZIP code, or address against listed service communities without rejecting unknown nearby leads.

tools.name: estimatePrice
tools.description: Return current public planning price ranges; never a binding quote.

tools.name: getHaulingPolicy
tools.description: Check special handling, assessment, advance-notice, and exclusion rules for unusual items and materials.

tools.name: getBusinessInfo
tools.description: Return public business, contact, region, service promises, and pricing-approach information.

tools.name: getQuoteLink
tools.description: Create a customer-review link to the quote form; never submits, consents, reserves, or books anything.

webmcp.note: Additional browser-local tools are registered in supported browsers when the customer has the site open.
